## CDLA-Permissive-2.0 (Standard Text)

完整文本见 https://cdla.io/permissive-2-0/ (5 段: Provision of Data / Conditions for Sharing / No Restrictions on Results / No Warranty / Definitions)

**核心条款** (5 段摘要):

### 1. Provision of the Data
> You may freely use, modify, and distribute the Data, **in any medium and for any purpose**, commercial or non-commercial.

### 2. Conditions for Sharing Data
> If you publish or distribute the Data, or any Derivative Work, you must:
> - Include a copy of this License;
> - Clearly mark any modifications you make;
> - Preserve any copyright notices.

### 3. No Restrictions on Results
> You may use the Data to **create, develop, train, and validate** any software, models, or other products, **without restriction** of any kind.

### 4. No Warranty; Limitation of Liability
> THE DATA IS PROVIDED "AS IS", WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED...

### 5. Definitions
> "Data" means the material you receive under this License...
> "Derivative Work" means any work that is based on, or derived from, the Data...
